item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 research contract - Department of Biological, Geological, and Environmental Sciences (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-24 Statistica medica, igiene generale e applicata e scienze infermieristiche generali, cliniche, pediatriche e ostetrico-ginecologiche e neonatali

Title of the project: “Integrated Microbiological Monitoring of Indoor Environmental Matrices: Development of Innovative Approaches for Environmental Quality Assessment in Healthcare and Community Settings” - The proposed research project builds on the expertise of the Laboratory of Environmental Microbiology and Molecular Biology (MAb Lab) in the microbiological monitoring of environmental matrices in healthcare and community settings. The project aims to develop an integrated approach to environmental microbiology, extending research activities from water matrices to air and surfaces using standardised culture-based methods and innovative techniques such as MALDI-TOF MS, LAMP and Next…
